fixes.explanation: That's right, friend. Jotham keeps out of the LORD's temple, and 2 Chronicles 27:2 says so plainly. Uzziah, Judah's king before him, did go in, and leprosy broke out on his forehead (2 Chronicles 26:16-21). So the two kings share one thing, doing what was right in the eyes of the LORD, but they part ways at the temple door.
